message.content:
An editorial illustration on a yellow background features "TEMPO" in large red letters. Beneath it is "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The main headline reads "CAWE-CAWE JOKOWI DI PILKADA JAKARTA" in black. A paragraph below details political maneuvering involving several names and the page number "H.28." At the top, two smaller headlines mention corruption and banking on pages "H.72" and "H.84."

On the right, a large silhouette of a man with glasses and a hand to his chin looks toward a smaller group on the left. This group consists of six figures huddled together, their arms draped over each other's shoulders. One figure in the center faces forward with a downcast expression. The others have their backs turned, wearing shirts in shades of blue, green, and gray. At the bottom left, text indicates "17-23 JUNI 2024," a price of "RP 50.000," website and ISSN details, a barcode, and a QR code. The overall composition uses flat colors and stylized, rounded shapes.
